clinical_trials.title: A Long-term Follow-up Study for Multiple Sclerosis Patients Who Have Completed the Alemtuzumab Extension Study (CAMMS03409)
clinical_trials.brief_summary:
Primary Objective:

To evaluate long-term safety of alemtuzumab.

Secondary Objectives:

* To evaluate long term efficacy of alemtuzumab.
* To evaluate the safety profile of participants who received other Disease Modifying Treatment (DMT) following alemtuzumab treatment.
* To evaluate participant-reported Quality of Life (QoL) outcomes and health resource utilization of participant who received alemtuzumab.
* To evaluate as needed re-treatment with alemtuzumab and other DMTs.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 感染相關 HLH（reactive HLH / infection-associated HLH）中，病毒誘發（尤其 EBV/CMV）的 CD8+ T 細胞及 NK 細胞失控活化是核心機轉。Alemtuzumab 的 CD52 靶向可快速清除這些過度活化的效應淋巴球，理論上直接干預發病機轉。關鍵直接證據：PMID 22426581（2012）報告成功以 Alemtuzumab 治療 SLE 合併 HLH，提供重要概念驗證（proof-of-concept）。PMID 34173902 進一步描述 T/EBV 相關 HLH 在非亞裔族群的特徵，支持 CD52 清除策略的生物學基礎。然而現有臨床試驗（NCT02255656、NCT00368355）均非針對 HLH 設計，證據仍限於個案層級。相較於惡性腫瘤相關 HLH，感染相關 HLH 在快速控制炎症後預後相對較佳，探索性試驗設計可行性較高。
